newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish January T-bill auction draws lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish January T-bill auction draws lower rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Thursday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.53 percent for the five-month series and 3.57 percent for the eight month series.
One month ago, the five month series, then with a maturity of six months, yielded 3.55 percent with the eight month series, at that time with a maturity of nine months, yielding 3.62 percent.
The central bank said it sold 1.450 billion crowns worth of the five month series and 3.925 billion crowns worth of the eight month series, giving a total of 5.375 billion crowns.
